title: Smart Reads of the Week: Singapore Dividend Stocks, REIT Payouts, and Small-Cap Opportunities
article:
US bond yields surged this week, with the 10-year Treasury yield reaching 5.2%, while oil remained volatile around US$100 to US$106. For income investors, both developments are a reminder that attractive yields need to be weighed against a changing market backdrop.
This week’s Smart Reads puts that focus on the strength behind the returns. We look at Temasek-backed blue chips raising dividends by more than 22%, S-REITs growing their DPUs by double digits, and five Singapore stocks that could provide investors with quarterly income.
We also tackle a familiar decision for Singapore investors: if you have S$10,000 to invest today, which dividend stocks deserve a closer look? And over a decade, how might dividend investing compare with leaving your money in CPF?
Beyond income, there have been some remarkable moves further down the market. AEM Holdings has delivered a 443% year-to-date return, while another SGX small cap has more than doubled the STI’s performance. The numbers are eye-catching, but the more important question is whether the businesses can keep delivering from here.
Here are this week’s top articles:
3 Temasek-Backed Blue Chips Raising Dividends by 22% or More
These Temasek-backed companies are rewarding shareholders with significantly higher payouts, but investors should examine what is driving the increases.
Oil Prices Over US$100: 3 Singapore Stocks Most at Risk
Higher oil prices can squeeze costs and margins, and these three Singapore companies could be particularly exposed.
5 Singapore Dividend Stocks That Could Pay You Every Quarter
For investors seeking regular cash flow, these five stocks could help create a more consistent stream of dividend income.
S$10,000 to Invest: 3 Dividend Stocks I Would Consider Today
If you had a fresh S$10,000 to deploy, these three dividend stocks offer a mix of income and long-term potential.
Top 4 S-REITs Raising DPU by 10% or More
These four S-REITs have delivered double-digit DPU growth, an encouraging sign for income investors looking beyond headline yields.
CPF vs Dividend Stocks: Which Could Generate More Income Over 10 Years?
We compare the stability of CPF with the income and growth potential of dividend stocks over a 10-year period.
AEM Holdings Has Delivered 443% Returns YTD: What’s Next?
AEM has been one of 2026’s standout performers, but its spectacular rally makes the outlook from here even more important.
Forget the Index: This SGX Small Cap More Than Doubled the STI’s Returns
This lesser-known company has raced ahead of the benchmark, showing why opportunities beyond Singapore’s largest stocks can be worth watching.
